data.name: Hotel NH Collection Guadalajara Providencia
data.address: São Paulo 2334, Providencia, 44630 Guadalajara, Jal., Mexico
data.description:
Set 3 km from 17th-century Basilica of Our Lady of Zapopan, this sleek high-rise hotel is 4 km from the Acuario Michin and 5 km from the Museo Panteón de Belén.
The refined rooms offer city views and sitting areas. All include free Wi-Fi and flat-screen TVs, along with minibars, and tea and coffeemaking facilities. Upgraded rooms add balconies or patios. Suites feature living areas. Room service is available 24/7.
Amenities include a sleek bar/restaurant and an exercise room. There's also a business center, 8 meeting rooms and a terrace. A breakfast buffet (fee) and parking are available.
